status: prospective follow-up to the completed frozen experiment; specified after inspecting original outcomes

heterogeneous_margins.M: minimum of saved primary balanced and mild shared_reachable_mi values
heterogeneous_margins.construction: P uses saved balanced primary P margins and interaction; Q uses saved mild primary Q margins and interaction; tune MI to 0.2M and (0.2+e)M

baseline_sensitivity.construction: saved primary different-shape margins, interactions and M; P target=bM, Q target=(b+e)M

allocation_reversal.construction: reuse every saved robustness_imbalance population pair exactly; exchange n_p and n_q without exchanging the populations
allocation_reversal.original_allocation: reuse saved original results for the larger-Q allocation

convergence.construction: reuse saved primary different-shape null populations; include saved n=1000 in plots

interpretation: exact regimes remain primary; validity, pointwise Wilson intervals and paired differences accompany operational rates; no universal superiority inferred from raw power
M_definition: a numerical scale demonstrated by the saved probe grid, not a theoretical maximum
construction_failures: record and fail preflight; do not replace a failed population based on test outcomes
storage: save exact populations, manifest, aggregate results, paired counts, input hashes and validation; no raw simulation tables
